contests.title: Kingsland — homestead exemption for growth in assessed value

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in an amount equal to the amount by which the current year assessed value of a homestead exceeds the base year assessed value of such homestead?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in an amount equal to the amount by which the current year assessed value of a homestead exceeds the base year assessed value of such homestead?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in an amount equal to the amount by which the current year assessed value of a homestead exceeds the base year assessed value of such homestead?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts the amount by which a qualifying Kingsland homestead’s current assessed value exceeds its base-year assessed value from city property taxes, including city bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. For the most recent owner, the base year is the tax year before the exemption is first granted; the homestead may include no more than five contiguous acres. The exemption does not cover improvements or land added after January 1 of the base year; removing land would reduce the base-year value and trigger recalculation. It adds to other city-tax homestead exemptions and does not apply to state, county or school property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the city-tax homestead exemption for qualifying growth above the base-year assessed value.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed exemption for growth in assessed homestead value.
